UI_PM_RandomizeTraits_Options_Preselect_: Allows you to pre-assign traits that must be included or excluded from the result.
UI_PM_RandomizeTraits_Options_HardPresel: Traits marked as Preselect will always be included in the result.
UI_PM_RandomizeTraits_Options_AutoReRand: Automatically re-randomize traits when changing profession, as selected traits may not suit the new profession.
UI_PM_RandomizeTraits_Options_ResetAllNo: Set every trait below to Normal. Press Apply or Accept to save.
UI_PM_RandomizeTraits_Options_PresetSlot: Choosing a saved slot loads its trait settings below (press Apply or Accept to save them). An empty slot changes nothing, so you can save the current settings into it.
UI_PM_RandomizeTraits_Options_PresetName: Name used when saving to the slot. If empty, a default name is used.
UI_PM_RandomizeTraits_Options_PresetSave: Saves the trait settings below to the selected slot right away, overwriting it. The checkboxes above are not included.
UI_PM_RandomizeTraits_TraitSetting_ToolT: Normal: random target / Exclude: excluded from random / Preselect: always included in result
